mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates and signals insufficient monetary policy accommodation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of all trading days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates delayed monetary policy easing during economic stress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals severe economic contraction, amplifying negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: negative returns in joint condition are not significantly more negative than individual conditions (p > 0.05 for interaction term).

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 growth rate < 0), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth rate < 0, INDPRO decline does not lead to negative returns (returns not significantly negative).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a negative economic outlook, reducing equity market returns and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of all trading days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600, it signals recovery in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of rising housing starts (HOUST > 1600) and expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals strengthening economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: positive returns in joint condition are not significantly more positive than individual conditions (p > 0.05 for interaction term).

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL growth rate < 2%), a rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL growth rate < 2%, a rise in CPIAUCSL does not lead to negative returns (returns not significantly negative).
